method: Independent visual review of real Chromium alpha compositing on dark, light and checker backgrounds; root review of light-background and source-comparison screenshots.

yellow-construction-mech:construction-re: Four crane arms, gray claws, three visible feet, open platform and gantry, cab and Japanese signs visually retained from accepted white-background illustration.
Transparent background visible between arms, gantry posts and legs; white sign plaques remain part of the opaque subject.
Sharper contours and more saturated colors than the accepted white-background image; this is a new generated output, not a pixel-identical extraction.
Rear surfaces, underside and fourth leg are not fully established by the two user frames.
yellow-pilot-robot:full-body-reference-v: Head, hands and feet wholly visible; clean silhouette on all three backgrounds.
Rectangular yellow faceless head, circular emblem, olive stepped neck and gray radial shoulders follow the cropped cockpit reference.
Hands, pelvis, legs and feet remain the first reconstruction; no new full-body source was found.
Changes are described as rendering and contour refinement; no corrected canonical lower-body geometry is claimed.
yellow-pilot-robot:fighter-cockpit-adapt: Full nose, both wingtips and tail visible, with native landscape proportions retained.
Tall gray canopy frame and seat, pilot head and segmented shoulders are legible and coherent with the supplied cockpit crop.
Opening inside the canopy frame is transparent; no white plate or visible glow remains.
Exterior aircraft geometry is inherited provisional reconstruction; no full-aircraft screencap or episode viewing supports it.

alphaReview.note: RGB values in fully transparent pixels can appear in previews that omit alpha compositing. In Chromium, alpha-zero pixels reproduce the background exactly.
